name: marker
useFor: Use separator for a date or a break between groups of messages, the default for an event in a thread (a card issued, a purchase made), border for a heading over a list, and unread for where new messages begin. Keep it to one short line.
constraints: A marker used as a heading
Colored lines other than the unread blue
source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the updates page's dates (agentcard.sh/updates) and the ink hairlines between its entries
title: Marker
description: A small display-face note in a conversation or feed: a date between hairlines, an event with a glyph, or the blue line where unread messages start.
